{{Quote|News, information and psychological warfare. We're very good.|Minos Porter.|audio=MinosPorter-WeAreVeryGood-TOR.flac|<ref name="Heartsandminds">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Hearts and Minds|Odessen}}</ref>}}
The '''Outreach Bureau''' or '''Imperial Outreach Division'''<ref name="Heartsandminds" /> was an agency of the reformed [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was responsible for the distribution of information and news. Their primary purpose was to spread propaganda and utilize information as psychological warfare against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] enemies.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], they were responsible for overriding [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] news feeds for months in order to broadcast propaganda. Their actions led to positive results as enemy morale and recruitment had fallen down due to their actions. This led to the [[Dark Council]] approving [[Project Eclipse]]. They recruited the aid of an Imperial representative to broadcast the message at the Hutt Data Haven on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

It was eventually renamed into the "''Imperial Outreach Division''" and counted prominent members like the charismatic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Izar]] to its organisation.<ref name="Heartsandminds" />
